title: IT link hub
short: Curated portals, docs and tools across networking, cloud, security, ops and AI
description: A vendor-neutral directory of useful IT links: networking, email, Linux, Windows, multi-cloud, DevOps, identity, security, ITSM, compliance and a dedicated AI link department — plus a condensed Microsoft aka.ms set.
intro: Bookmarks for day-to-day IT work across disciplines, not only Microsoft admin portals. Prefer official docs and stable product pages. Listings are not an endorsement to put company data into any SaaS or model — see the AI department for governance links.
guardrails: External sites have their own terms and privacy policies. Prefer read-only docs first; never paste secrets or regulated data into public tools.
